title: Complementary p-basis monomials
statement: Let $p$ be prime and $k$ a field of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-field]. Let $(t_i)_{i\in I}$ be a family whose bounded finitely supported monomials $\prod_i t_i^{E_i}$, $0\le E_i<p$, form a basis of $k$ over $\mathbf F_p(k^p)$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Let $J\subset I$ be finite and let $k_J$ be the subfield generated by all $p$-th powers in $k$ and by the $t_i$ with $i\notin J$. Then there is a $k_J$-basis $b$ of $k$, indexed by all functions $E:J\to\{0,\ldots,p-1\}$, such that $b(E)=\prod_{i\in J}t_i^{E_i}$.

lean.statement:
theorem pBasisComplementMonomialBasis
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k p]
    (I : Type w) (t : I → k)
    (hpb : ∃ b : Module.Basis
      {E : I →₀ ℕ // ∀ i : I, E i < p}
      (IntermediateField.adjoin (ZMod p) (Set.range (fun x : k ↦ x ^ p))) k,
      ∀ E, b E = (E : I →₀ ℕ).prod (fun i e ↦ t i ^ e))
    (J : Finset I) (kJ : Subfield k)
    (hkJ : kJ = Subfield.closure
      (Set.range (fun x : k ↦ x ^ p) ∪ {x : k | ∃ i : I, i ∉ J ∧ t i = x})) :
    ∃ b : Module.Basis (J → Fin p) kJ k,
      ∀ E, b E = ∏ i : J, t i ^ (E i : ℕ)
